text:
Type: striped rolled-arm armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, coastal, classic
Materials: striped cotton-like upholstery fabric, dark wood tapered legs
Colors: cream white, light grey stripes, dark espresso
Shape: rounded tight back, scrolled rolled arms, deep seat, wide vertical stripes, short tapered dark legs, medium and generous
Feel: fresh, relaxed, inviting
Goes with: white walls, navy or grey accents, natural wood; coastal or classic living rooms

product.name: Pinzon Crescent Bay Armchair, Stripe
product.description: Handsome arm chair in versatile, blue and beige wide-striped fabric enhances any decor Hardwood frame; foam cushion; helical springs for comfort; hand crafted in the USA 100-percent organic cotton fabric needs only spot cleaning for care; no assembly required Coordinates with the Pinzon Crescent Bay Furniture Collection Chair measures 37 inches high by 34 inches wide by 34 inches deep
